title: Tab control with many tabs
description: Code-style rule — tab controls with more than six tab panels. Too many tabs hide content and are hard to navigate. Threshold adjustable via the header slider (default 6).
author: fm-lab rules

rule.rationale: A tab control with many tabs buries content and signals an overloaded layout.
rule.remediation: Split the content across layouts, or group tabs into sub-navigations.
